subject: Migrate quicklist unit test to new framework (#515)
reason: The change migrates the quicklist unit tests from the legacy SERVER_TEST embedded framework to the new unit-test framework: it deletes #ifdef SERVER_TEST test code from quicklist.c and server.c, adds src/unit/test_quicklist.c, and updates the Makefile and CI. The only lines that newly compile into the server are the two node->attempted_compress assignments whose SERVER_TEST guards were removed; attempted_compress is a pre-existing 1-bit struct field read only by tests and a debug printf, with no production logic branching on it. No command reply, encoding, replication or persistence behavior c
